title: PO sections
summary: The heading each item prints under on a vendor's PO, so the vendor can pick the order aisle by aisle.

blocks.text: A **PO section** is the heading an item prints under on a vendor's PO PDF, such as "Dairy" or "Frozen - Ice Cream". Sections print A to Z with items sorted by name. Lines with no section print under **Other**, always last.

items: **Automatic** is the section RetailOps picks from the item's category and name.
On the **Items** tab, change one item, or tick several and set their section. Type a new name to make a new section. **Back to automatic** undoes it.
**Vendor rules** put every item from one vendor in a section, now and in future uploads.
An item's own rule wins over a vendor rule.
The **Sections** tab renames or merges sections, and moves all of a section's items.
**PDF preview** shows a vendor's cart grouped exactly as its PDF.

blocks.text: In the cart, editors can change a line's section with its small Section link. Every change records who and when, and the latest can be undone. Only the PO section changes, never the item's category in {pos}.
Admins and anyone with the **Edit PO sections** access can change sections.
